records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Contract liabilities relate to advance consideration received from customers or advance billings for which revenue has not been recognized and are reduced when the associated revenue from the contract is recognized.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue recognized during the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023 that was included in contract liabilities at the beginning of the period amounted to $112,211 and $131,563, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Depreciation expense totaled $39,404 and $37,530 for the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, amortization expense was $45,305 and $40,366, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The restructuring expenses of $18,655 incurred during the three months ended March 31, 2024 were primarily related to product line exit costs and headcount reductions in the Climate & Sustainability Technologies, Clean Energy & Fueling and Pumps & Process Solutions segments.
